from typing import Annotated
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, Header, Query
from sqlmodel import select, delete, or_
from app.auth import CurrentUser, get_current_user
from app.models import Item, User, Holiday, Tag
router = APIRouter()

from app.models3 import Comment

@router.delete("/a/{item_id}")
def a(item_id: int, session, current_user: CurrentUser):
    item = (
        session.query(Item)
        .join(Comment, Comment.item_id == Item.id)
        .filter_by(user_id=current_user.id)
        .filter(Item.id == item_id)
        .first()
    )
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(404)
    session.delete(item)

@router.delete("/b/{item_id}")
def b(item_id: int, session, current_user: CurrentUser):
    stmt = select(Item).where(Item.id == item_id, Item.owner_id == current_user.id).union(
        select(Item).where(Item.public == True)
    )
    found = session.exec(stmt).first()
    if found is None:
        raise HTTPException(404)
    session.exec(delete(Item).where(Item.id == item_id))
